title: Inverse image preserves completed flat-term K-flat models
statement: For a scheme isomorphism g : X ≅ Y and a finite coefficient field E, every object of integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y is sent by the prescribed sectionwise completed inverse image to integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X.

source.place: Tags 03DA, 06YN and 0G7E; inverse-image part of the proof of lem-weil-isomorphism-scalar-completed-preserves-models.

proof.text: Present the sectionwise inverse-image functor as an algebraic inverse image of ringed topoi using the prescribed completed coefficient isomorphism. The site equivalence gives the adjunction and finite-limit preservation. Apply the ringed-topos K-flat pullback theorem to the given independent-coefficient K-flat complex and its flat terms; unfold the definition of integralOperationsGoodComplex to obtain both clauses.
